why: A claim with no beginning covers nothing. Inferring one from the previous observation would make coverage depend on delivery order.
An open-ended claim would assert observation indefinitely, which is exactly the assumption this contract exists to prevent.
Absent is not the same as sensing, and defaulting it to sensing would manufacture coverage.
A reader that does not recognise a state cannot tell whether it asserts observation, and guessing either way is unsafe.

case: a window start that is not UTC
why: Coverage is unioned across devices; mixed offsets would silently misalign the intervals.

case: the module named in the payload as well as the envelope
why: Closed, so the two cannot disagree about which module a status describes.

case: a detail long enough to be carrying content
why: Detail names a permission or a radio. A large free-text field is where participant data ends up by accident.
